Stay Away from This Lender!  -100 point for customer service:

I had one of the worst experiences with this private finance company. Please read carefully before applying for a loan:

Hidden & Unfair Charges: I was charges penalty for basic loan documents that was summited at taken at the time of sanction of loan but they couldn't find it.

Poor Online Portal: Their website rarely works properly. Logging in is difficult, and I couldn’t download my loan statements or documents. never gets any proper response from email. Query remains unresolved. even their grievance redressal doesn't work .

Unclear Interest Rate Practices: My loan tenure and interest rate were changed without any notice, and when repo rates dropped, I didn’t get any benefit.

Unprofessional Customer Service: I personally visited their head office at Prabhadevi but was not allowed to meet any customer executive. They made me wait in the security guard room below the building, took my phone number, and said I would get a call — i have to wait for their call at security guard office.

Is this what they call customer service? Very disappointing experience overall. I would strongly advise others to be extremely cautious before dealing with this lender.

• Terrible Online Portal – Their website barely works. Most of the time you can’t log in, and even if you do, you cannot download statements or important documents.
• Zero Transparency in Payment Slips – The EMI slips only show the total amount deducted. They never show principal vs. interest breakup.
• Unethical Interest Rate Practices – They increase loan tenure and interest rates without informing you. If repo rates drop, they never pass on the benefit.
• Relationship Manager Disappears – After disbursement, the relationship manager will stop responding to calls. Even if they answer, they give vague and unhelpful responses.
• Foreclosure Scam –
• First, they ask to see your bank balance.
• Then, they delay your foreclosure request (claiming it takes 2 months).
• If you insist on faster processing, they shamelessly ask you to pay 2 extra EMIs.
• Even after waiting 2 months, they add an extra EMI + other charges in the foreclosure letter.
⚠️ Final Advice: Please don’t take a home loan from this company unless it’s the last option on earth. They trap customers with lies, hidden charges, and unethical practices.

featured_reviews.name: shalini solkar
featured_reviews.review_text:
Bank bazaar suggested me HDFC bank for home loan balance transfer and top up loan . HDFC was quick enough to contact me and take required docs from me. Had informed them from day 1 that I don’t have OC with me. They insisted they can still process the loan and nothing to worry about. They charged me with7k+gst for application itself which is non refundable. And 6k+gst for some processing fee etc which is refundable.
After 2.5 months and rigorous follow ups I was informed that the loan has been rejected.
They took 1 week to return my docs and am still waiting for the 6k to be returned.
It seems that HDFC is running out of money and hence looting innocent people like me for mere 7k.
Disgusting service.
Don’t ever apply in HDFC and also don’t ever take the suggestions on Bank bazaar.
